user.title: Music Light Synk
user.description: Creates colour entities from the Music Light Synk TV app. Then add this webhook ID to the app's "Webhook ID(s)" setting, comma separated, e.g. music_light_synk,music_light_synk_entities. Don't reuse the blueprint's webhook ID.

error.webhook_in_use: This webhook ID is already in use (probably by the blueprint automation). Pick another one.

abort.already_configured: This webhook ID is already set up
